app.name: TDC
app.tagline: Where the community talks, plans, and finds each other.

auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth.endingSessionSignsOut: Ending a session signs that device out immediately.
auth.addressConfirmedDetail: If you ever forget your password, you can set a new one through it.
auth.communityDescription: Channels and threads for discussion, projects to track the work, and a directory connecting developers with the people who need them. Run on your own server, by the community, for the community.
auth.confirmationLinkExpiredDetail: Links work once and last a day, and asking for a new one replaces the old. You can ask again from your settings.
auth.freeAndOpenSource: Free and open source. Self-hosted, always.
auth.passwordChangedDetail: Every device that was signed in has been signed out. Sign in with the new password.
auth.recoveryLinkExpiredDetail: It has been used already, or the hour it lasts has passed. Asking again will send a fresh one.
auth.setNewPasswordDetail: Choose something you will keep. There is no password reset beyond this one.
auth.setUpThisServerDetail: This account becomes the server's administrator. It can only be created once.
auth.usernameBecomesAddress: Your username becomes your address on this server.
auth.twoStepHint: A code from an app on your phone, as well as your password. Somebody who learns your password still cannot sign in.
auth.twoStepRequired: This server requires two-step sign-in on your account. Set it up to carry on.
auth.recoveryCodesHint: Each works once, for the day you cannot reach your app. Write them down or keep them somewhere safe — this is the only time they are shown.
auth.addToAuthenticator: Add this to your authenticator app
auth.addToAuthenticatorHint: Scan the code in your app, or type the key below if you cannot scan.
auth.passkeyAlreadyCovers: Your passkey already covers this — signing in with your password asks for it as the second step. An authenticator app is an alternative, not a requirement.
auth.turnOffPasswordHint: Your password, to confirm this is you. Turning this off also removes your recovery codes.
auth.recoveryLinkOnWay: If there is an account with that address, a link to set a new password is on its way. It works once, and for an hour.
auth.recoveryNothingArrived: Nothing arrived? Check the address you typed, and the spam folder. If the account has no confirmed email address, an administrator is the only way back in.
auth.forgottenPasswordHint: Give the email address on your account and we will send a link to set a new password.
auth.oauthExpired: That sign-in took too long. Try again.
auth.oauthAlreadyAttached: That account is already connected to a different account here.
auth.oauthFailed: The provider could not complete the sign-in. Try again.
auth.connectToAccountHint: An account here already uses that email address. Sign in to it once and this provider will work on its own from then on.
auth.chooseUsernameHint: This is how people will see you here. It does not have to match the one you use elsewhere.
auth.enterYourCodeHint: From your authenticator app. If you cannot reach it, one of your recovery codes works here too.
auth.emailedCodeOnWay: A code is on its way to the address on your account. Enter it above — it works once, for five minutes.
auth.sendCodeToEmail: Send a code to my email instead
auth.recoveryCodesLeftSingular: You have {count} recovery code left. Make more from your settings once you are in.
auth.recoveryCodesLeftPlural: You have {count} recovery codes left. Make more from your settings once you are in.
auth.passkeysHint: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. The key stays on your device.
auth.noPasskeysYet: You have none yet. Adding one takes a moment and means you can sign in without typing anything.
auth.couldNotStartSetup: Could not start setting this up.
auth.sixDigits: Six digits, from your authenticator app.
auth.passkeyNotAdded: That passkey could not be added.
auth.passkeyNotRemoved: That passkey could not be removed.
auth.tooManyAttemptsMinutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {count} minute(s).
auth.tooManyRequestsMinutes: Too many requests. Try again in {count} minute(s).
auth.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Try again later.
auth.passkeyDidNotSignIn: That passkey did not sign you in.
auth.providerPasswordGoesHere: Your password for that account goes here.
auth.usernameCharacters: Letters, digits, hyphen and underscore only.
auth.codeOrRecovery: The code from your app, or a recovery code.
auth.tooManyCodes: Too many codes have been tried. Sign in again to start over.
auth.addressForLink: An address to send the link to.
auth.notAnEmail: That does not look like an email address.
auth.emailOnAccount: The email address on your account.
auth.couldNotCompleteSignIn: That sign-in could not be completed.
auth.usernameGoesHere: Your username or email goes here.
auth.linkMissingToken: That link is missing its token.
auth.confirmLinkUnusable: That link could not be used. Ask for another from your settings.

nav.searchHint: Find a channel, somebody to talk to, or something that was said.
nav.searchFailed: The search could not be completed. Try again.
nav.pickConversation: Pick a conversation from the sidebar to carry on where you left off.
nav.joinToStart: Join a channel from the sidebar, or create one to get started.
nav.serverUnreachable: This server is not reachable right now. Its rooms will appear again when it returns.
nav.noPublishedRooms: This server publishes no rooms you can browse.

room.hostedElsewhereHint: This room is hosted on {server}. If that server is unavailable, the room is too.
room.showingAsItWas: Showing this conversation as it was {when}
room.offlineWillLoad: You are offline. This conversation will load when the connection comes back.
room.noRepliesYet: No replies yet. Start the discussion.
room.scheduledForLater: Scheduled. It will send at the time you chose.
room.reportedToModerator: Reported. A moderator will look at it.
room.actionFailed: That could not be answered. Try again.

formatting.helpIntro: Type these, or select text and use the buttons or keys.
formatting.enterInFence: Inside an open code block, Enter starts a new line. Close the block with ``` and Enter sends again.

room.channelRetention: This channel keeps messages for a set time.
room.serverRetention: This server keeps messages for a set time.
room.sendingFullSize: Sending images at full size. Click to reduce them instead.
room.reducingImages: Images are reduced before sending. Click to send them at full size.
room.blockDetail: {name} will not be able to start a conversation with you. They are not told.
room.goesOnceRead: This message goes once everybody has read it.
room.goesAfterEachRead: This message goes a set time after each person first reads it.
room.goesAfterSent: This message goes a set time after it was sent.
room.couldNotFindToBlock: Could not find that person to block.
room.couldNotFindToBan: Could not find that person to ban.
room.noPinPermission: You do not have permission to pin messages in this channel.
room.nowhereToForward: There is nowhere else to forward this. Join another conversation first.

channel.name: Name
channel.noPermission: You do not have permission to create channels on this server.

lifetime.afterSendingHint: It goes when the time is up, whether or not anybody read it.
lifetime.onceSeenHint: It goes as soon as the last person opens the conversation.
lifetime.afterSeeing: A set time after each person reads it
lifetime.afterSeeingHint: Everybody gets the same window, however long they took to look.
lifetime.title: When this message expires
lifetime.visibleToAll: Everybody in the conversation can see that this message will expire. A lifetime can be made shorter afterwards, never longer.

channel.slugRule: Letters, digits, underscore, dot and hyphen.
channel.nameBecomesAddress: The name becomes the channel's address, so people on other servers can reach it.
channel.disposableHint: Messages are removed after a set time. Everyone in the chat is told before they post.

attachment.failed: That file could not be sent.
attachment.gifsUnreachable: The GIF library could not be reached.
attachment.fileUnreadable: The file could not be read ({status}).
attachment.replyUnreadable: The server's reply could not be read.
attachment.uploadUnreachable: The upload could not reach the server.
attachment.tooLarge: That file is larger than this server allows.
attachment.notAccepted: This server does not accept that kind of file.
attachment.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in and try again.
attachment.noUploadPermission: You do not have permission to upload here.
attachment.fileUnreachable: The file could not be reached.
attachment.showingFirstKb: Showing the first {size} KB. Download the file to read all of it.

notification.title: Notifications
notification.whileClosed: Told about a message while TDC is closed. Each device is separate.
notification.keepOffLockScreen: Keep messages off my lock screen
notification.keepOffLockScreenHint: A notification says something arrived, not what it said.
notification.blockedInBrowser: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser's settings.
notification.notSetUp: This server has not set up notifications.
notification.browserCannot: This browser could not register for notifications. Its push service is unavailable, which is a limit of the browser rather than of this server — TDC still notifies you while it is open.
notification.staleKey: This device is subscribed with a key this server no longer uses. Removing it below and subscribing again will fix it.
notification.couldNotSubscribe: This device could not be subscribed.
notification.couldNotRemove: That device could not be removed.
notification.couldNotSaveSetting: That setting could not be saved.

reasons.webhookDisabled: Your webhook “{name}” was turned off after repeated failures

digests.title: Summaries by email
digests.hint: Instead of being interrupted, get one email listing what went unread. It says where and how much, never what was said.
digests.off: Off — notify me as things happen
digests.needsAddress: A summary is sent only to an email address you have confirmed. Confirm one above to turn this on.
digests.replacesPush: While this is on, your devices are not notified. Everything still appears in your notification list.
digests.couldNotLoad: Could not read your summary setting.
digests.couldNotSave: Could not save your summary setting.

settings.title: Settings
settings.statusHint: What others see beside your name. Your server's administrator chooses which are available.
settings.appearanceHint: Following your device is the default, and changes with it.
settings.languageHint: What this application speaks to you in.
settings.gettingAroundHint: The short introduction to the application, if you would like it again.
settings.privacyHint: Who may start a conversation with you. Existing conversations are unaffected by narrowing this.
settings.anyoneHint: Anybody on this server can start a conversation with you.
settings.sharedChannel: People I share a channel with
settings.sharedChannelHint: Colleagues can reach you; people you have never met cannot.
settings.nobodyHint: No new conversations. Moderators can still reach you, so that nobody is beyond contact by the people responsible for this server.
settings.blockedHint: People you have blocked cannot start a conversation with you. They are not told, and this list is yours alone.
settings.accentHint: The colour on buttons and links. Adjusted for light and dark so its label stays readable in both. Leave it empty for the one this palette comes with.
settings.coloursHint: Each works in both light and dark.
settings.endSessionDetail: {device} will be signed out straight away, in the middle of whatever it is doing. Whoever is using it is not told why, and will have to sign in again.
settings.moderatorCanSeeDisclosure: A moderator reviewing a report can see what you have turned off, and every time they do it is written to the audit log.
settings.showsLastSeenHint: A record of when you work and when you stop, if it is shown.
settings.showsPresenceHint: Turning this off does not disconnect you or change what you receive.
settings.showsStatusHint: The status you have chosen and the note that goes with it.
settings.unblockDetail: They will be able to start a conversation with you again. They are not told that they were blocked, or that they no longer are.
settings.whatOthersCanSee: What others can see about you
settings.whatOthersCanSeeHint: Your name and address are always shown. Anything you turn off here is left out of what the server sends, not hidden afterwards.

calls.title: Who may call you
calls.hint: Ringing you is more intrusive than writing to you, so it has its own setting. Somebody refused is not told why.
calls.shared: People you share a conversation with
calls.sharedHint: Somebody must be in a channel with you to ring you.
calls.nobodyHint: Nobody can ring you. You can still join calls yourself.
calls.otherServersHint: Whether people on servers this one is connected to may ring you, where your server allows it at all.

settings.couldNotSave: That change could not be saved. Try again.
settings.showsTyping: Show others when I am typing
settings.showsTypingHint: Turned off, nobody sees that you are writing, on any device.

accentRefused.unmeasurable: That colour could not be read. Use a hex value like #4f46e5, or an oklch() colour.
accentRefused.unreadable: No shade of that colour can be read in both light and dark. Try one with more colour in it — a near-grey has nowhere to move to.

update.typedIsKept: What you have typed is kept.

conversations.title: Your conversations
conversations.body: Channels you have joined, and the people you are talking to. Whatever you were last reading is where you come back to.

finding.title: Finding something
finding.body: Search messages, channels and people from here — or press the shortcut shown, from anywhere.

starting.title: Starting a channel
starting.body: A channel is a room for a subject. Anyone on this server can be in one, unless you make it private.

missed.title: What you have missed
missed.body: Unread messages gather here. You decide per channel how much you want to hear, in its settings.

error.generic: The server could not complete the request.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.

moderation.allDealtWith: Every report has been dealt with.
moderation.banAppliesToChannelOnlyHint: A ban applies to this channel only. Everything else they belong to is untouched.
moderation.banConsequenceHint: They will be removed from this channel and cannot rejoin it. Everything else they belong to is untouched.
moderation.cannotReadQueue: You cannot read the moderation queue.
moderation.cannotSeeWhoIsBanned: You do not have permission to see who is banned here.
moderation.keptOnRecordHint: Kept on the record as considered and not acted on.
moderation.liftBanConsequence: {username} will be able to rejoin this channel and post in it again.
moderation.nextModeratorWillReadHint: The next moderator to see this person reported will read this.
moderation.nobodyBannedFromThisChannel: Nobody is banned from this channel.
moderation.notAnonymousHint: A moderator will see this message and what you have written. Reporting is not anonymous to them.
moderation.reportedOldestFirstHint: What people have reported, oldest first. The person reported is never told who reported them.
moderation.reportingUnavailable: Reporting is unavailable at the moment.

admin.anyServerExceptThoseListed: Any server except those listed below
admin.anyServerThatProvesWhoItIs: Any server that proves who it is
admin.auditLogHint: Every security- and administration-relevant action, most recent first. Reading this log is itself recorded.
admin.cannotManagePeople: You cannot manage people on this server.
admin.capabilityNotChanged: That capability could not be changed.
admin.capabilityOffHint: A capability turned off here is refused by the server and is not advertised to clients, so the control disappears rather than failing.
admin.couldNotLoadAuditLog: Could not load the audit log.
admin.deliverAndShowModerator: Deliver it, and show a moderator
admin.deliverWithWordsReplaced: Deliver it with the words replaced
admin.invitationLinkAndCode: A link, and a short code for reading aloud. Both last a week.
admin.notConfiguredYetHint: Nothing is configured for this yet, so it stays unavailable.
admin.readOnlyConfigurationHint: Read-only. These come from the environment or the configuration file and need a restart to change. The source says whether a value was chosen or merely inherited.
admin.recordedShownToReviewerHint: Recorded, and shown to whoever reviews this later.
admin.sayWhyHint: Say why, for whoever reviews this.
admin.shareNowNotShownAgain: Share this now — it is not shown again.
admin.suspendConsequenceHint: Their sessions end at once and they cannot sign in. What they have written stays where it is.
admin.suspendingEndsSessionsHint: Suspending somebody ends their sessions and stops them signing in. Their messages stay.
admin.suspensionNotLifted: That suspension could not be lifted.
admin.withdrawConsequenceHint: The link stops working immediately. Anybody holding it will not be able to join, and will not be told why.

integrations.accessLost: You can no longer read this channel, so nothing is being sent.
integrations.addressShownOnce: The address for “{label}”. Copy it into the other system now — it is not shown again.
integrations.appPurposeRequired: Say what it is for, so whoever approves it knows.
integrations.cannotManageApplications: Managing applications needs the server.applications.manage permission, which you do not hold.
integrations.cannotManageIncoming: You cannot manage this channel's incoming webhooks. Somebody who can — an administrator, or whoever runs the channel — can make one for you.
integrations.channelRequired: Choose the channel whose events to send.
integrations.controlsChanged: That question changed while you were answering. Look again.
integrations.couldNotLoad: That could not be loaded. Try again.
integrations.couldNotSave: That was not saved. Try again.
integrations.credentialShownOnce: The credential for “{name}”. Put it in the application now — it is not shown again.
integrations.disclosureRequired: Say what leaves the server and where it goes.
integrations.endpointHint: An http or https address. Addresses on private networks are refused unless the operator allows them.
integrations.eventTypeRequired: Choose at least one kind of event.
integrations.externalDisclosureHint: Shown to whoever approves it, before they do, and to everybody afterwards.
integrations.failingNow: The last {count} attempts failed. It is still being retried.
integrations.heldBackCount: Held back by the rate limit {count} times, most recently {when}. Nothing was dropped.
integrations.incomingHint: An address another system posts into a channel through — a build server, an alerting tool. Its messages are marked as coming from it, never from a person. Anybody holding the address can post with it, so revoke it if it leaks.
integrations.installedHint: Programs installed on this server as themselves, with what each may do. Anybody can see this list, and which applications can act in any channel they can see.
integrations.invocationHint: Where presses on its messages are sent, signed and retried like a webhook's, for an application that holds no live connection. Leave empty to stop.
integrations.invocationSecretOnce: The secret its invocations are signed with. Put it in the application now — it is not shown again.
integrations.invokedAt: Presses on its messages are sent to {host}
integrations.label: Label
integrations.labelRequired: Say what this webhook is for.
integrations.noApplicationsHere: No application can act in this channel.
integrations.noIncomingYet: This channel has no incoming webhooks.
integrations.notYourAuthority: It holds these and nothing else — none of your own authority comes with it.
integrations.outgoingHint: Each one sends a channel's events to an address you choose, signed so the receiver can prove they came from this server. Only channels you can read can be chosen, and delivery stops if you stop being able to read one.
integrations.refusedCount: {count} refused by the rate limit, most recently {when}
integrations.registerHint: Registering grants nothing. Whoever approves it is shown exactly what it asks for, and decides where it may act.
integrations.removeContentHint: Each is taken down as a moderator's removal is, leaving a placeholder.
integrations.removeHint: Its credentials stop working at once, and it leaves its channels.
integrations.removeWebhookDetail: “{label}” stops receiving events at once, and its delivery history is deleted.
integrations.retainContentHint: They stay where they are, still marked as the application's.
integrations.revokedWhen: Revoked {when}. Calls to its address are refused.
integrations.revokeIncomingDetail: “{label}” stops working at once. Whatever posts through it gets a refusal from its next call; messages it already posted stay.
integrations.rotationHint: Issue a new credential before revoking the old one, and the application can switch over without a gap.
integrations.secretShownOnce: The signing secret for “{label}”. Copy it into your receiver now — it is not shown again.
integrations.sendsDataExternally: It sends data to a service outside this server
integrations.settingsHint: Webhooks that tell other services what happens in your channels.
integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.turnedOffBecause: Turned off {when}: {reason}. Nothing is being sent until you turn it back on.
integrations.urlInvalid: That is not an http or https address.
integrations.waitingDeliveries: {count} waiting to be sent, the next by {when}.
integrations.whatCanActIn: Which can act in a channel
integrations.willHoldExactly: It will hold exactly these permissions

directory.title: Directory
directory.intro: People on this server who chose to be found, and the companies they agreed to be listed by. Nobody appears here without deciding to.

visibility.publicHint: Anyone who can browse this server's directory, including people not signed in.
visibility.membersHint: People signed in to this server.

form.notAnEmail: That is not an email address.
form.notAWebLink: Use a web link starting with http:// or https://.

profile.title: Your directory profile
profile.whoCanFindYouHint: Whether your profile appears in the directory at all. Nothing in it is ever more visible than this.
profile.aboutYouHint: All optional. Say as much or as little as you like.
profile.headline: Headline
profile.experienceHint: For example, eight years building backends.
profile.portfolioEmpty: Links to work you have done.
profile.whoSeesDetailsHint: Your headline, location, experience, about, portfolio and companies.
profile.contactHint: Separate from the rest, and hidden until you choose otherwise. Being findable is not the same as being reachable.
profile.whoSeesContactHint: Even set to anyone, nobody sees them unless they can see your profile.
profile.deleted: Your profile is deleted. Your account and messages are as they were.
profile.noneYetHint: A profile lets clients and other developers find you. It is entirely optional: without one, everything else works as it does now, and nobody can find you here.
profile.seeAsOthers: See it as a member would
profile.deleteDetail: It leaves the directory at once. Your account, messages and sessions are not affected.
profile.notFoundHint: Either there is no such person, they have no profile, or it is not visible to you.
profile.thisIsYou: This is your profile, as a member sees it.

company.createHint: You become its first administrator. Nobody else is listed until they accept.
company.noneYet: You are not part of any company here.
company.askedYou: Asked you to be listed on {date}
company.acceptMeans: Accepting shows your name on the company's page to everyone who can see it, and the company on your profile.
company.slugRule: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 40.
company.name: Name
company.slugHint: Part of the page's link. It cannot be changed later.
company.notFound: No such company, or it is not visible to you.
company.inviteHint: They are listed only once they accept, from their own profile page.
company.invited: Asked {name}. They will be listed once they accept.
company.deleteDetail: Its page goes, and nobody is listed by it any longer. People's own profiles are not affected.
company.removeDetail: They stop being listed at once, on the company's page and on their profile.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Chosen from the server's list, so people searching for a skill find everybody who has it.
skills.describe: What you have done with it (optional)
skills.notInVocabulary: {skill} is not on the list yet.

availability.title: Availability
availability.closedHint: Say so when you are looking. It lapses on its own, so a profile you stop looking after does not keep saying you are free.
availability.noteHint: For example, short contracts or part time.

search.label: Search the directory
search.queryHint: A name, or words from a headline
search.empty: Nobody is in the directory yet
search.emptyHint: People appear here once they create a profile they let you see.
search.nobodyMatchesHint: Only what people chose to show you can be searched.
search.slowDown: That is a lot of searching in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

review.title: Review
review.skillsHint: Approve a skill to add it to the list, merge it into one the list already has under another name, or reject it. Each decision is recorded.
review.why: Why? This is kept with the record.

verification.meaning: A moderator, {by}, checked the evidence for this one claim on {date} and judged it credible. It is not an endorsement of the person, their work, or whether they will deliver.
verification.editClears: Editing a verified claim clears its verification: what you change is not what the moderator checked.
verification.title: Verify claims
verification.reviewHint: Open a profile, check the evidence for one claim at a time, and say what you checked. A verification is about that claim only, and is recorded.
verification.whatYouCheckedHint: What you checked, for the record

enquiry.title: Enquiries
enquiry.takeThemHint: Separate from who may send you direct messages. Until you choose, a public profile takes enquiries and any other does not.
enquiry.oneMessage: One message about the work. {name} decides whether to take it further; you cannot add to it until they do.
enquiry.subject: Subject
enquiry.bodyHint: What it is, roughly when, and anything they need to decide.
enquiry.notTaking: {name} is not taking enquiries through the directory.
enquiry.slowDown: You have sent a lot of enquiries recently. Wait a while and try again.

engagement.title: Engagements
engagement.noneHint: An enquiry becomes an engagement when the person it was sent to takes it up.
engagement.notFound: No such engagement, or you are not part of it.
engagement.withdrawDetail: It closes for both of you and cannot be reopened. The conversation is kept, and stops taking new messages.
engagement.withdrawWhy: Why, if you want to say (the other person will see it)
engagement.withdrawnHint: Withdrawn before any agreement. Nothing was agreed, and the conversation is closed.
engagement.noProjectToLink: You are in no project to track this work in.
engagement.linkHint: Project members see the issues, never the proposal, prices or this conversation.

agreement.noProposalHint: Either of you can write a proposal: what the work is, by when, and what each part costs.
agreement.timelineHint: For example: six weeks from agreement.
agreement.currencyHint: A three-letter code, such as TZS.
agreement.currencyInvalid: Use a three-letter code, such as TZS.
agreement.amountInvalid: Each price must be a number in the chosen currency, not negative, with no more decimal places than the currency has.
agreement.youAccepted: You accepted this version. The agreement is recorded when {name} accepts it too.
agreement.theyAccepted: {name} accepted this version. Accepting it too records the agreement.
agreement.completeNote: A note for {name}, if you want
agreement.complete: The work is complete: ask {name} to confirm
agreement.awaitingTheirs: You said the work is complete. It stays outstanding until {name} confirms.
agreement.awaitingYours: {name} says the work is complete. Confirm when you agree.
agreement.completed: Both of you confirmed the work is complete.

projects.title: Projects
projects.views: Ways of looking at this project
projects.couldNotLoad: This could not be loaded. Try again.
projects.couldNotStart: The project could not be started.
projects.couldNotFile: The issue could not be filed.
projects.couldNotMove: The issue could not be moved.
projects.couldNotSave: The change could not be saved.
projects.couldNotDelete: The issue could not be deleted.
projects.movedMeanwhile: Somebody moved this issue while you were looking at it. It now shows where it actually is.
projects.startHint: A project holds issues, each named by the project's key and a number: WEB-12.
projects.name: Name
projects.keyHint: Two to ten letters or digits. It starts every issue's identifier and never changes.
projects.keyRule: A key is two to ten letters or digits, starting with a letter.
projects.visibilityHint: A public project is visible to everybody on this server. A private one exists only for its members.
projects.noneYetHint: Start one to track what was agreed in a conversation, who is doing it, and whether it is done.
projects.titleTooLong: A title is at most two hundred characters.
projects.deleteIssueHint: It disappears from lists and boards. Its history is kept, and its number is never given to another issue.
projects.statesHint: The columns of the board, left to right. Issues in a state marked done count as finished.
projects.removeStateHint: Every issue in it moves to the state you choose, and each move is recorded in that issue's history.

history.uncycled: {actor} took this out of its cycle
history.unmilestoned: {actor} took this out of its milestone
history.carried: When {from} ended, the server carried this forward to {to}
history.carriedOut: When {from} ended, the server took this out of it, with no next cycle to carry it to

priority.title: Priority
priority.scaleHint: Most urgent first. Sorting by priority follows this order, whatever the levels are called.

fromMessage.title: Create an issue from this message
fromMessage.hint: The message is kept as a link, not copied. Anybody opening the issue sees it only if they could read it here.
fromMessage.chooseProject: Choose a project to file it in.
fromMessage.noProjects: There is no project you can file issues in yet.
fromMessage.linkHint: The issue will show where it came from, and this message will show the issue.

origin.title: Where this came from
origin.undisclosed: This issue was made from a message in a conversation you cannot see.
origin.removed: The message in {room} it was made from has been removed.

search.title: Search issues
search.statePlaceholder: Any state, or one by name
search.label: Label
search.failed: The search could not be completed. Try again.
search.hint: Search by words, or narrow by state, label and who an issue is assigned to — or both. Only issues in projects you can see are ever found.

board.pickedUp: Picked up {issue} from {state}. Left and right arrows choose a column; Enter puts it there.

roles.cannotManage: You cannot manage roles on this server.
roles.loadFailed: The roles could not be loaded.
roles.notFound: There is no such role. It may have been deleted.
roles.builtInHint: Built-in roles cannot be deleted. Change what they allow instead.

roles.name: Name
roles.descriptionHint: A line other administrators will read before handing it out.
roles.notCreated: The role could not be created.
roles.notDeleted: The role could not be deleted.
roles.permissionsHint: Allow grants it to everybody holding this role. Deny takes it away even where another role allows it. Unset leaves it to their other roles.
roles.baselineNote: Everybody holds Member. What it says is a baseline: any other role's entry for the same permission, in the same place, replaces it — in either direction.
roles.administersNote: This role administers the server, so its holders may already do everything below except what it denies.
roles.notChanged: That permission could not be changed.
roles.inChannelsHint: Entries made for one channel, which decide there in place of what this role says server-wide. Add them from a channel's settings.
roles.goneChannel: A channel that no longer exists
roles.goneProject: A project that no longer exists
roles.everyoneHoldsMember: Everybody who joins this server is given Member.
roles.notAssigned: That role could not be given.
roles.notRemoved: That role could not be taken away.
roles.ownAuthorityDetail: This takes {permission}, or something like it, from a role you hold. You will not be able to undo it yourself.
roles.lookUpHint: Find a person to see every permission they hold, and which role gives it to them.
roles.personLoadFailed: What this person may do could not be loaded.
roles.noRolesHeld: They hold no roles, so they may do nothing that needs a permission.
roles.administratorNote: They administer the server: everything is allowed unless one of their roles denies it, and Member's baseline does not apply to them.

picker.found: {count} found. Use the arrow keys to choose.

consequence.baselineGrants: Everybody has this, unless another of their roles says otherwise.
consequence.baselineDenies: Withheld from everybody, unless another of their roles grants it.
consequence.baselineSilent: Not given to everybody. Only roles that allow it give it.
consequence.denies: Holders cannot do this, even where another role allows it.
consequence.impliedByAdministration: Already allowed: this role administers the server.
consequence.alsoBaseline: Member already gives this to everybody. This keeps it for holders if Member's is withdrawn.
consequence.fromBaseline: Holders have this anyway, from Member.
consequence.notFromThisRole: Not from this role. Holders have it only if another role allows it.

reason.administrator: Allowed because they administer the server.
